page.overview:
Who is Elrood I al-Aziz?

Emperor Elrood I al-Aziz (d. 104 AG), also known simply as Elrood I, was the sixth Emperor of the Known Universe (r. 73–104 AG), succeeding his brother Henoor II Negara I as ruler of the Corrino Imperium.

Elrood I was a son of Emperor Saudir I. He became emperor after the brief reign of his brother, Henoor II Negara I (r. 70–73).

Elrood was assassinated in 104. He was then replaced on the throne by his brother-in-law, Alman bin Haig (as Emperor Alman I), while his nephew and rightful heir, Saudir II Negara II, fled into exile.
